line.en: the christmas market is open daily from 11:00 to 19:00 until 22 december, the glühwein restaurant until 20:00. free entry. by 17:00 it is already dark, so the lights do the work.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt ist täglich von 11 bis 19 uhr offen, bis 22. dezember; das glühwein-restaurant bis 20 uhr. der eintritt ist frei. ab 17 uhr ist es schon dunkel, die lichter machen den rest.
line.tr: joulu pazarı 22 aralık'a kadar her gün 11:00 ile 19:00 arası açık; glühwein restoranı 20:00'ye kadar. giriş ücretsiz. saat 17:00'de hava çoktan kararmış olur, ışıklar işi görür.

sparks.why: Tampere Christmas Market (joulutori) runs to 22 Dec 2026, daily 11:00-19:00, per the city of Tampere event listing and joulutori.tampere.fi; start dates differ between sources (21/22/28 Nov), but 1 Dec is inside the run on every version.
